meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 这个技能让 NanoClaw 的 agent 获得把网页应用部署到 Vercel 的能力。安装后会自动装好 Vercel 命令行工具、配置访问令牌（需要时向你索要），并将技能同步到所有已运行的 agent，之后它们就能用 vercel 命令部署。
howto.when: 当用户想让 agents 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发，例如要求“部署到 Vercel”或提到 vercel 相关操作。

say.text: 请给我的 agents 添加部署到 Vercel 的能力。
say.note: 触发技能，自动检查安装并配置凭据。

say.text: 我需要把网站部署到 Vercel，先帮我配好工具。
say.note: 会安装 Vercel CLI 并可能要求你提供访问令牌。

say.text: 给所有运行中的 agent 装上 Vercel 部署技能。
say.note: 技能会同步到所有 agent 组并重启容器生效。

howto.what_en: NanoClaw agents get Vercel deployment capability. This installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers, configures an access token (asking you when needed), syncs the skill to all running agents, and lets them use vercel deploy commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel, e.g. asks 'deploy to Vercel' or mentions Vercel deployment.

say_en.text: Please add Vercel deployment capability to my agents.
say_en.note: Runs the skill; it checks and configures credentials.

say_en.text: I need to deploy a site to Vercel, set up the tooling first.
say_en.note: Installs Vercel CLI and may ask for an access token.

say_en.text: Install the Vercel deployment skill on all running agents.
say_en.note: Syncs to agent groups and restarts containers to apply.
